recommended_fix: Re-derive and update the warn.dem golden-stream tick list from the re-blessed warn.t1 (amber now lands at tick 2).

title: W9's 'window spawns ≥ 95%' pin counts the whole run (ticks 1..=SURGE_END), adding ~1199 pre-window spawns of slack
detail: The message says 'window spawns', but the counter includes the 1199 pre-window base spawns (~6.7% of expected), so a window landing only ~88% still passes the 95% claim.
recommended_fix: Only count spawns with spawn_tick in [SURGE_START, SURGE_END) toward stream_spawned/MIN_LAND.
